## Just the animation

<!-- Records what a manim block *without* a surrounding explain construct
     yields: an `.r-stack` of `.step` divs carrying `show-from`. Only stepper.lua
     turns those into reveal fragments, and it only reaches inside a `.stepper`
     div — so here it stays at visibly stacked videos. Whoever wants to step
     through a bare block wraps it in `::: {.stepper}` themselves. -->

```{.python .manim}
from manim import *


class DefaultTemplate(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.next_section("one")
        self.next_section("two")
```
